html:
Given a string, return a list of [character, count] pairs for consecutive equal-character runs. Return [] for an empty string.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "wwaaa!"
  ],
  "expected": [
    [
      "w",
      2
    ],
    [
      "a",
      3
    ],
    [
      "!",
      1
    ]
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    ""
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Only the latest run can be extended.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(n) output space
